description:
- Improved automatic fallback when addon or torrent sources fail.
- Failed torrent preparation, decoding, or stalled direct addon streams now automatically move to the next available source.
- Playback position is preserved when switching to a fallback source.
- Failed sources are not retried endlessly, while manually selecting a source starts a fresh attempt.
- Added addon catalog sections to the Home screen after the original Phantom Movies sections.
- Addon catalog previews load only when near the visible area for better performance.
- Added optimized poster row recycling and bounded catalog caching to reduce memory usage.
- Addon Home previews show up to 20 titles with See all available for the full catalog.
- Returning to a cached addon shelf now restores its previous horizontal scroll position.

releases.description:
- Improved Torrentio support with the native torrent engine now starting automatically when Phantom Movies opens.
- Torrent discovery stays ready while the app remains open for faster stream startup.
- Updated the background server notification with Phantom Movies branding and the ghost notification icon.
- Updated addon filters, stream cards, and torrent engine settings with Phantom Movies styling.
- Added Cinemeta catalogs and improved compatibility with addon redirects and older catalog filters.
- Added account sync for favorites and addon configurations across supported devices.
- Added live sync updates, offline retry, and synced removals for favorites and addons.
- Improved watch history synchronization and account isolation.
- Fixed missing episode navigation data and improved Next Episode behavior.

releases.description:
- Added Torrentio addon support.
- Torrentio sources now appear directly in the player alongside regular servers.
- Torrentio streams are prioritized and the first available source is selected automatically.
- Added seeders and file size information for Torrentio sources.
- Added a new Addons section in Profile for managing installed addons.
- Addons can be configured, searched, and uninstalled from the app.
- Regular servers are still used automatically if Torrentio is unavailable or returns no streams.
